svg.title: SDT swinging door animation
svg.desc: Animated illustration of the Swinging Door Trending algorithm walking through a 20-point time series. The doors narrow as each sample arrives, and a new anchor is placed whenever the doors would cross. Retained points are 0, 6, 8, 14, and 19 at compdev 0.05.
svg.text: SDT: swinging door compression, step by step
compdev = 0.05 • 20 samples → 5 retained • reconstruction error bounded by 2 × compdev = 0.10

text.tspan: Anchor at point 0. Doors narrow as each sample lands inside the corridor.
Retain point 6. New anchor at point 6, doors reopen.
Retain point 8. New anchor at point 8, doors reopen for the descent.
Retain point 14. New anchor at point 14, doors reopen for the recovery.
Point 19 retained as the final sample. Five points retained in total.
points 0, 6, 8, 14, 19. Reconstruction error is bounded by 2 × compdev = 0.10.
